training: Only original v1 train; development and calibration retain original v1 partitions; old test is observed regression only.
fresh: Authored new wording against the same fixed 58-document corpus. Includes previously trained topics; not semantic OOD, private traffic or independent human review.
protocol: Four 13-parameter linear fits, anchor strengths .02/.1, seeds42/97. RankNet pair loss .75 + balanced BCE .25; lexical anchor w0=5, other coefficients/bias zero; bounded AdamW batch16 queries lr.01 max80epochs patience12 clip5. Select development top1 then MRR then fewer parameters then NLL, with per-language top1 no-regression floor. Include lexical control. Calibrate only original calibration. Export source before fresh/observed scoring.
